models.description: Union Alpha through the opencode Go subscription using the Messages API. OpenCode publishes this as a stealth model and does not name its maker. The 262,144-token window and 131,072-token output limit are OpenCode's models.dev figures for this id. Compact-at-window-minus-output (131,072) still 400s on Console Go because that edge refuses a prompt plus completion that does not fit every available backend; live Codex turns reported ~90–100k input tokens, then hit that 400. Codex therefore compacts at 80,000, and the Messages hop caps max_tokens at 32,768. OpenCode documents reasoning but publishes an empty effort list, so the stored single high level is this repository's conservative default. Access is currently free for a limited time.
models.availabilityNux: Union Alpha is OpenCode Go's new stealth coding model. Access is currently free for a limited time.
